title: Healing Hangover Tunisian Milk Pudding
description: A rich and aerated Tunisian dessert featuring condensed milk to help cure hangovers, this pudding is a Buddhist-temple-friendly treat that is easy to make and fun to eat. It is a delicious and soothing dessert that can be enjoyed at any time of day.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the whole milk, sugar, and cornstarch, and whisk until the cornstarch is dissolved.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the condensed milk, rose water, orange blossom water, and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Cover the saucepan with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, whip the pudding with an electric mixer until it is light and airy.
Spoon the pudding into individual serving cups and serve chilled.
Garnish with a sprinkle of cinnamon or a few sliced almonds, if desired.
